output.summary: A genus of flowering herbs and low shrubs abundant around the Mediterranean, the Balkans, Iberian Peninsula and Macaronesia, and also found in Central Europe and temperate Asia. They are generally short and hairy, often growing at high elevations on rocks with little soil. Several named species and other members of section Empedoclia are boiled as herbal tea using stems, leaves and flowers.
